# Codextor

> Codextor is a free, browser-based coding school. It teaches programming through
> interactive lessons that pair reading with a live editor, a console, and
> self-checking exercises — no videos, no paywall, and no build setup. Everything
> runs client-side in the learner's browser.

Codextor covers 17 tracks and 118 hands-on lessons spanning web
fundamentals, TypeScript, React, back-end and APIs, Python, data structures and
algorithms, Git, testing, DevOps, security, architecture, performance, and AI
agents. Progress, streaks, and badges sync to a free account, and learners can
compare scores on weekly leaderboards or form guilds.

## Curriculum

- [Interactive lessons](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/learn): 17 tracks of guided, runnable lessons across the full modern web stack.
- [Syllabus](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/): every track with its learning outcomes and full outline, readable without JavaScript.
- [Live playground](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/playground): a scratch editor for writing and running code outside the lessons.

## Tracks

- [Web Development Foundations](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/web/): 10 lessons. HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript — the bedrock every frontend stands on.
- [Git, GitHub & Workflows](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/git/): 4 lessons. Version control, branches, PRs, and shipping pipelines — how teams actually work.
- [Testing & Debugging](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/testing/): 7 lessons. Write tests that catch bugs, hunt down the ones that slip through, and read production incidents. Watch after DevOps — its logs and containers vocabulary carries over.
- [Working with Coding Agents](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/agents/): 23 lessons. Operate the tool: write specs an agent can execute, read unfamiliar code, manage context, approve plans, choose permissions, and verify what ships.
- [Professional Workflow](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/workflow/): 4 lessons. PRs, review, tickets and decision records — the written work that decides whether code ships.
- [Web Security & OWASP](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/security/): 7 lessons. Think like an attacker: XSS, SQL injection, CSRF, CORS, and the habits that keep apps safe.
- [TypeScript for Real Projects](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/typescript/): 6 lessons. The real compiler runs in your editor: write types, watch diagnostics with line and column, and ship code the compiler has already argued with.
- [Backend Systems & APIs](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/backend/): 5 lessons. Node.js, Express, REST design, auth, and databases that don't fall over.
- [Modern Frontend: React](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/react/): 4 lessons. Components, hooks, and the mental model behind every modern interface.
- [API Integration & Data Fetching](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/api/): 6 lessons. Talk to real services: HTTP, errors, races, optimistic updates, and a resilient client.
- [Data Structures & Algorithms](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/dsa/): 8 lessons. Big-O thinking, classic structures, and the patterns interviewers actually ask.
- [Python & Data Fundamentals](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/python/): 4 lessons. Python syntax, OOP and the pandas/numpy workflow — three lessons now execute in the browser (Pyodide).
- [DevOps, Linux CLI & Cloud](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/devops/): 6 lessons. Command the terminal, write Bash, containerize with Docker, and ship behind Nginx.
- [System Design & Architecture](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/architecture/): 6 lessons. Scale, cache, shard, and queue — the trade-off thinking behind big systems.
- [UI Engineering with Tailwind CSS](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/tailwind/): 6 lessons. Utility-first styling, responsive systems, and shipping a real component kit.
- [Advanced React State Management](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/state/): 6 lessons. Reducers, context without the re-render tax, external stores, and server state.
- [Web Performance & Accessibility](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/syllabus/performance/): 6 lessons. Core Web Vitals, layout stability, contrast and keyboard semantics — measured, graded, and shipped as one audit-ready page.

## Practice and projects

- [Projects](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/projects): larger builds that combine lessons into shippable deliverables.
- [Portfolio](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/portfolio): a learner's completed work and certificates in one place.

## Community

- [Leaderboards](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/leaderboard): weekly, monthly, and all-time rankings by experience points.
- [Guilds](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/clans): small teams that pool experience and unlock collective rewards.

## Get started

- [Home](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/): an overview of the school and a way into the lessons.
- [Create a free account](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/auth): save progress and sync it across devices.
